name: insider_trades
description: SEC Form 4 insider transaction filings for a US-listed company: filing date, the officer/director/10%-owner who filed, and a link to the filing on EDGAR. Answers who at a company has been buying or selling its stock recently. Ticker or company name is resolved to a CIK, so results are that issuer's filings.

ticker.description: Stock ticker ("AAPL", "NVDA"), company name ("NVIDIA Corp"), or CIK

name: insider_8k
description: SEC Form 8-K material event filings for a US-listed company, with the 8-K item codes decoded (earnings release, acquisition completed, officer departure, material agreement, delisting notice…). Answers what significant corporate events a company has disclosed and when.

ticker.description: Stock ticker ("AAPL"), company name, or CIK

name: insider_13d
description: SEC Schedule 13D and 13G beneficial-ownership filings naming a US-listed company: which fund or investor crossed 5% ownership, on what date, and a link to the filing. 13D signals activist intent, 13G passive. Answers who has accumulated a large stake in a company.

ticker.description: Stock ticker ("AAPL"), company name, or CIK

name: insider_activity_summary
description: One-call SEC filing overview for a US-listed company: Form 4 insider transactions and 8-K material events from the last 90 days plus Schedule 13D/G stake filings from the last year, with counts and the most recent rows of each. Answers what has been happening at a company lately, for quick due diligence.

ticker.description: Stock ticker ("AAPL", "TSLA", "NVDA"), company name, or CIK
